text: Electrical engineering is an engineering discipline centered around "the generation, transmission, distribution, conversion, control and application of electrical energy". It is the cornerstone of modern science and technology as well as industrial development. Based on electromagnetism (circuit theory, electromagnetic field theory), it integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as electronics technology, control science, and computer technology. It not only studies the stable operation of traditional power systems but also explores cutting-edge technologies like new energy generation, smart grids, and power electronics. It plays an irreplaceable supporting role in industrial production, residents' lives, and national defense technology, and is the "nerve of industry" and the "core of the energy internet".
